name: u_mappedUcmisItemsRdfTokens
description: Returns a sequence of RDF mapping token strings from the property "uml-map-rdf", split by comma.
params: anEObject - Only used as entry point.

name: u_mappedUcmisItemsRdf
description: Returns a sequence of source IRI strings from the RDF mapping tokens (the part before ">").
params: anEObject - Only used as entry point.

name: u_mappedUcmisItemsRdfTargets
description: Returns a sequence of target IRI strings from the RDF mapping tokens (the part after ">").
params: anEObject - Only used as entry point.

name: u_testPackages
description: Returns an ordered set of package names defined in the property TEST_PACKAGE.
params: anEObject - Only used as entry point.

name: packageQuery
description: Module contains queries with a UML pcakage as receiver.

name: u_childClasses
description: Returns the classes directly owned by the specified package, sorted by name.
params: aPackage - A UML package whose directly owned classes are to be retrieved.

name: u_childPackages
description: Returns the packages directly owned by the specified package, sorted by name.
params: aPackage - A UML package whose directly owned packages are to be retrieved.

name: u_isAllowedPackage
description: Returns true if the specified package is the main package or a non-ignored child of the main package.

name: u_isNotIgnoredPackage
description: Returns true if the specified package is not listed in the IGNORE_PACKAGE property (comma-separated list of package names).

name: u_childrenDataTypes
description: Returns a sequence of data types directly contained in the specified package.

name: u_childrenEnumerations
description: Returns a sequence of enumerations directly contained in the specified package.

name: dataTypeQuery
description: Module contains queries with a UML data type as receiver. This includes queries for navigating the data type hierarchy (supertypes, subtypes), finding properties that use a data type, and data type classification.  Note: Queries applicable to both classes and data types are in classifierQuery, since both are subtypes of Classifier.  Related modules: - classQuery: queries with a UML class as receiver - classifierQuery: queries with a UML classifier as receiver, applicable to both classes and data types

name: u_subDataTypes
description: Returns an ordered set of direct sub datatypes of a datatype, sorted by datatype name. --- AQL operations used: eInverse(uml::Generalization) - Finds all Generalization elements that cross-reference aDataType; requires all resources to be loaded in the same resource set. Returns both generalizations where aDataType is the general end AND where aDataType is the specific end — hence the guard below is mandatory. ->select(g1 | g1.general      - Retains only Generalization elements where = aDataType)        aDataType is the general (parent) end, excluding generalizations where aDataType is the specific (child) end. Without this guard, aDataType itself leaks into the result via .specific on its own supertype relationships. ->collect(g2 | g2.specific)   - Retrieves the specific (child) classifier of each qualifying Generalization element. ->filter(uml::DataType)       - Retains only uml::DataType instances, excluding non-DataType specializations and dropping null values safely. ->sortedBy(c | c.name)        - Sorts result alphabetically by datatype name.
params: aDataType - A UML datatype whose direct sub datatypes are to be retrieved.

name: u_allSubDataTypes
description: Returns an ordered set of all sub datatypes of a datatype, traversing the full specialization hierarchy down to the leaves. Supports both single and multiple inheritance. Cycle-safe. --- AQL operations used: ->closure(c | expr)    - Applied to aDataType itself as seed; the lambda c.u_subDataTypes() is evaluated starting from aDataType, so direct sub datatypes are included from the first step. Traverses transitively until no new elements are found. Cycle-safe: each element is visited at most once. Returns OrderedSet(uml::DataType) — no cast required. ->sortedBy(c | c.name) - Sorts the full result alphabetically by datatype name.
params: aDataType - A UML datatype whose full sub datatype hierarchy is to be retrieved.

name: u_usingClasses
description: Returns an ordered set of classes which use the specified data type, sorted by class name. Navigates the inverse usage links from the data type, selects only those whose owner is a class, collects and casts the owning classes, and deduplicates.
params: aDataType - A UML data type whose using classes are to be retrieved.

name: u_usingDataTypes
description: Returns an ordered set of data types which use the specified data type, sorted by data type name. Navigates the inverse usage links from the data type, selects only those whose owner is a data type, collects and casts the owning data types, and deduplicates.
params: aDataType - A UML data type whose using data types are to be retrieved.

name: u_usingProperties
description: Returns an ordered set of properties (attributes) that use the specified data type, excluding association ends and properties owned by the data type itself, sorted by the owning classifier name.
params: aDataType - A UML data type whose using properties are to be retrieved.

name: u_abstractionClientsDataType
description: Returns an ordered set of client data types of all abstraction dependencies that target the specified data type, sorted by name. Navigates inverse abstraction links from the data type, collects their clients, and retains only data type instances.
params: aDataType - A UML data type whose abstraction clients are to be retrieved.

name: u_abstractionSuppliersDataType
description: Returns an ordered set of supplier data types of all abstraction dependencies that target the specified data type, sorted by name. Navigates inverse abstraction links from the data type, collects their suppliers, and retains only data type instances.
params: aDataType - A UML data type whose abstraction suppliers are to be retrieved.

name: u_attributes
description: Returns a sequence of owned attributes of the specified data type, sorted by attribute name. Excludes association ends, retaining only plain attributes owned directly by the data type. Applies to all subtypes of uml::DataType, including uml::Enumeration and uml::PrimitiveType. Note: See the overloaded variants for classes and classifiers: u_attributes(uml::Class), u_attributes(uml::Classifier).
params: aDataType - A UML data type whose owned attributes are to be retrieved.

name: u_allSuperDataTypes
description: Returns an ordered set of all super datatypes of a datatype, traversing the full generalization hierarchy up to the root. Supports both single and multiple inheritance. Cycle-safe. --- AQL operations used: ->closure(c | expr)    - Applied to aDataType itself as seed; the lambda c.general->filter(uml::DataType) is evaluated starting from aDataType, so the direct parent is included from the first step. Traverses transitively until no new elements are found. Cycle-safe: each element is visited at most once.
params: aDataType - A UML datatype whose full supertype hierarchy is to be retrieved.

name: u_isGeneralDataType
description: Returns true if the specified data type is a general (parent) data type, i.e. it has at least one specializing sub data type.
params: aDataType - A UML data type to check.

name: u_dataTypeUseProperties
description: Returns an ordered set of properties whose type is the specified data type. Excludes association ends and properties owned by the data type itself, i.e. returns only attributes of other classifiers that reference this data type.
params: aDataType - The data type to find usages of.

name: u_inheritedDataTypeAttributes
description: Returns a sequence of inherited attributes of the specified data type. Excludes own attributes.
params: aDataType - A UML data type whose inherited attributes are to be retrieved.

name: u_contextPackages
description: Returns an ordered set of packages of the context classifiers of the specified data type, excluding the data type's own package, sorted by package name. See also: u_contextPackages(uml::Class)

name: u_limitedDataTypeUseProperties
description: Returns at most the first 3 properties that use the specified data type, to keep diagrams manageable.

name: u_contextClassesOrDataTypes
description: Returns an ordered set of classifiers related to the specified data type as context classifiers for diagram generation: - classifiers that own properties using the data type - all super data types - classifiers that own properties using any super data type (limited to 3 per super type) - all sub data types - abstraction clients of the data type - abstraction suppliers of the data type The data type itself is excluded from the result.  Note: p.owner is typed as uml::Element and requires an explicit oclAsType(uml::Classifier) cast. Sub- and super data types as well as abstraction helpers returning OrderedSet(uml::DataType) do not need a cast since DataType is a subtype of Classifier and AQL widens the union automatically.

name: configurationQuery
description: Module contains queries that retrieve configuration values from the generator properties file. Property keys are constructed dynamically using the 'subset.name' property as a prefix.

name: u_subsetPrefix
description: Returns the subset name prefix used to build property keys. Returns an error marker string if 'subset.name' is not defined, ensuring misconfiguration is visible in generated output.

name: u_subsetTitle
description: Returns the title of the subset.

name: u_subsetClasses
description: Returns a sequence of names of the subset classes. Returns an empty sequence if the property is not defined.

name: u_subsetGeneralizedClasses
description: Returns a sequence of names of the generalized subset classes. Returns an empty sequence if the property is not defined.

name: u_subsetAllClasses
description: Returns a sequence of names of all subset classes (subset classes and generalized subset classes).

name: u_subsetDataTypes
description: Returns a sequence of names of the subset data types. Returns an empty sequence if the property is not defined.

name: u_subsetEnumerations
description: Returns a sequence of names of the subset enumerations. Returns an empty sequence if the property is not defined.

name: u_subsetItems
description: Returns a sequence of names of all subset items (classes, data types, and enumerations).

name: u_subsetClassAttributes
description: Returns a sequence of attribute names for a specific subset class. Returns an empty sequence if the property is not defined.
params: aClassName - The name of the class.

name: u_subsetDataTypeAttributes
description: Returns a sequence of attribute names for a specific subset data type. Returns an empty sequence if the property is not defined.
params: aDataTypeName - The name of the data type.

name: classQuery
description: Module contains queries with a UML class as receiver. This includes queries for navigating the class hierarchy (superclasses, subclasses), finding associations, inherited attributes, and class classification.  Note: Queries applicable to both classes and data types are in classifierQuery, since both are subtypes of Classifier.  Related modules: - dataTypeQuery: queries with a UML data type as receiver - classifierQuery: queries with a UML classifier as receiver, applicable to both classes and data types - associationQuery: queries with a UML association as receiver - propertyQuery: queries with a UML property as receiver

name: u_inheritedClassAttributes
description: Returns a sequence of inherited attributes of the specified class, i.e. properties inherited from its superclass hierarchy that are not association ends. Excludes own attributes and inherited association ends.
params: aClass - A UML class whose inherited attributes are to be retrieved.

name: u_allSuperClasses
description: Returns an ordered set of all superclasses of a class, traversing the full generalization hierarchy up to the root. Supports both single and multiple inheritance. Cycle-safe. --- AQL operations used: ->closure(c | expr)    - Applied to aClass itself as seed; the lambda c.general->filter(uml::Class) is evaluated starting from aClass, so the direct parent is included from the first step. Traverses transitively until no new elements are found. Cycle-safe: each element is visited at most once.
params: aClass - A UML class whose full superclass hierarchy is to be retrieved.

name: u_rootSuperClasses
description: Returns a sequence of all root superclasses in the specified package and its sub-packages. A root superclass is a class that has no superclasses itself but is a generalisation parent of at least one other class. The parameter can be any uml::Package, including the model root, to scope the search accordingly.
params: aPackage - A UML package to search within. Can be the model root or any sub-package.

name: u_subClasses
description: Returns an ordered set of direct subclasses of a class, sorted by class name. --- AQL operations used: eInverse(uml::Generalization)    - Finds all Generalization elements that cross-reference aClass; requires all resources to be loaded in the same resource set. Returns both generalizations where aClass is the general end AND where aClass is the specific end — hence the guard below is mandatory. ->select(g1 | g1.general=aClass) - Retains only Generalization elements where aClass is the general (parent) end, excluding generalizations where aClass is the specific (child) end. Without this guard, aClass itself leaks into the result via .specific on its own superclass relationships. ->collect(g2 | g3.specific)      - Retrieves the specific (child) classifier of each qualifying Generalization element. ->filter(uml::Class)             - Retains only uml::Class instances, excluding non-Class specializations and dropping null values safely. ->sortedBy(c | c.name)           - Sorts result alphabetically by class name.
params: aClass - A UML class whose direct subclasses are to be retrieved.

name: u_allSubClasses
description: Returns an ordered set of all subclasses of a class, traversing the full specialization hierarchy down to the leaves. Supports both single and multiple inheritance. Cycle-safe. --- AQL operations used: ->closure(c1 | expr)     - Applied to aClass itself as seed; the lambda c1.u_subClasses() is evaluated starting from aClass, so direct subclasses are included from the first step. Traverses transitively until no new elements are found. Cycle-safe: each element is visited at most once. ->sortedBy(c2 | c2.name) - Sorts the full result alphabetically by class name.
params: aClass - A UML class whose full subclass hierarchy is to be retrieved.

name: u_isSuperClass
description: Returns true if the specified class is a superclass of at least one other class, i.e. if it has at least one direct subclass.
params: aClass - A UML class to test for being a superclass.

name: u_incomingAssociatedClasses
description: Returns an ordered set of all classes that are sources of incoming binary directed associations pointing to the specified class. Uses eInverse() to find all uml::Property elements whose type cross- references aClass, then resolves the source class via getOtherEnd(). Only source-class-owned ends (ownedAttribute) are considered. Self-associations are excluded. --- AQL operations used: eInverse(uml::Property)        - Finds all Property instances whose type EReference cross-references aClass; requires all resources to be loaded in the same resource set. ->select(p1 | cond)            - Keeps only source-class-owned association ends pointing to aClass, excluding those owned by aClass (self-associations). p1.association                 - EReference: the owning Association element; null if not an association end. eContainingFeature().name      - Returns the name of the EReference via which p is contained; 'ownedAttribute' confirms the property is source-class-owned, not owned by the Association itself (ownedEnd). p1.eContainer() <> aClass      - Excludes self-associations: a self-association is exactly the case where the source-owned end is contained by aClass itself. ->collect(p2 | expr)           - Transforms each qualifying property. p2.getOtherEnd()               - Java method on uml::Property: returns the opposite end of a binary association. Not an EStructuralFeature; must be called with explicit parentheses in AQL. .type                          - EReference: the classifier typing the other end (uml::Type); narrowed by filter below. ->filter(uml::Class)           - Retains only uml::Class instances; also drops null values safely. ->asOrderedSet()               - Deduplicates the result collection. ->sortedBy(p3 | p3.name)       - Sorts result alphabetically by class name.
params: aClass - The target class whose incoming association source classes are to be retrieved.

name: u_outgoingAssociatedClasses
description: Returns all classes that are targets of outgoing binary directed associations from the specified class. Alphabetically sorted, deduplicated set of classes reachable via outgoing associations. Navigates via ownedAttribute ends that belong to a uml::Association, collecting their target types. Self-associations (where the class is associated with itself) are excluded from the result. --- AQL operations used: ownedAttribute             - EReference: properties structurally owned by this class (uml::Property). ->select(p | cond)         - Keeps only elements satisfying the condition. p.association              - EReference: the Association this property is a member end of; null if plain attribute. ->collect(p | expr)        - Transforms each element to the given expression. p.type                     - EReference: the classifier typing this property (uml::Type); narrowed to uml::Class by filter. ->filter(uml::Class)       - Retains only instances of uml::Class; also drops null values safely. ->reject(c1 | c1 = aClass) - Excludes self-associations. ->asOrderedSet()           - Deduplicates the result collection. ->sortedBy(c2 | c2.name)   - Sorts alphabetically by class name.
params: aClass - The source class whose outgoing association targets are to be retrieved.

name: u_associatedClasses
description: Returns all classes associated with the specified class, combining both outgoing and incoming binary directed associations. Delegates to u_incomingAssociatedClasses() and u_outgoingAssociatedClasses(), merges the results, deduplicates, and sorts alphabetically by name. Self-associations are excluded.

name: u_effectiveIncomingAssociatedClasses
description: Returns an ordered set of all classes that reference the specified class as a target via incoming binary directed associations, including associations inherited from its superclass hierarchy. Combines the class itself with all its superclasses, then collects incoming association sources across the full hierarchy, deduplicating the result. --- AQL operations used: u_allSuperClasses()               - Query: returns the ordered superclass hierarchy of aClass. ->including(aClass)            - Adds aClass itself to the collection so its own associations are included. ->collect(c1 | expr)           - Collects incoming associated classes for each class in the hierarchy. u_incomingAssociatedClasses()  - Query: returns direct incoming association sources of a single class. ->asOrderedSet()               - Deduplicates; a class may be reachable via associations at multiple levels. ->sortedBy(c2 | c2.name)       - Sorts result alphabetically by name.
params: aClass - A UML class whose full effective incoming association sources (own and inherited) are to be retrieved.

name: u_effectiveOutgoingAssociatedClasses
description: Returns an ordered set of all classes reachable via outgoing binary directed associations from the specified class, including associations inherited from its superclass hierarchy. Combines the class itself with all its superclasses, then collects outgoing association targets across the full hierarchy, deduplicating the result. --- AQL operations used: u_allSuperClasses()            - Query: returns the ordered superclass hierarchy of aClass. ->including(aClass)            - Adds aClass itself to the collection so its own associations are included. ->collect(c1 | expr)           - Collects outgoing associated classes for each class in the hierarchy. getOutgoingAssociatedClasses() - Query: returns direct outgoing association targets of a single class. ->asOrderedSet()               - Deduplicates; a class may be reachable via associations at multiple levels. ->sortedBy(c2 | c2.name)       - Sorts result alphabetically by name.
params: aClass - A UML class whose full effective outgoing association targets (own and inherited) are to be retrieved.

name: u_allEffectiveAssociatedClasses
description: Returns an ordered set of all classes reachable via any binary directed association from or to the specified class, including associations inherited from its superclass hierarchy. Combines the results of u_effectiveOutgoingAssociatedClasses() and u_effectiveIncomingAssociatedClasses(), deduplicating the result. --- AQL operations used: u_effectiveOutgoingAssociatedClasses() - Query: returns all classes reachable via outgoing associations across the full superclass hierarchy. u_effectiveIncomingAssociatedClasses() - Query: returns all classes referencing aClass via incoming associations across the full superclass hierarchy. ->union(col)                              - Merges both collections, deduplicating the result as an OrderedSet. ->sortedBy(c | c.name)                    - Sorts result alphabetically by name.
params: aClass - A UML class whose full effective associated classes (both incoming and outgoing, own and inherited) are to be retrieved.

name: u_allIndirectSuperClasses
description: Returns an ordered set of all indirect superclasses of a class, i.e. the full superclass hierarchy excluding the direct parent. Delegates to u_allSuperClasses() and removes the direct parent. Note: Works only for single inheritance.
params: aClass - A UML class whose indirect superclass hierarchy (excluding direct parent) is to be retrieved.

name: u_incomingAssociations
description: Returns an ordered set of all incoming binary directed associations of the specified class, i.e. associations where another class owns the source end via ownedAttribute and this class is the target type. The Association elements themselves are returned, not the source classes. Self-associations are excluded. --- AQL operations used: eInverse(uml::Property)        - Finds all Property instances whose type EReference cross-references aClass; requires all resources to be loaded in the same resource set. ->select(p1 | cond)            - Keeps only source-class-owned association ends pointing to aClass, excluding those owned by aClass itself (self-associations). p1.association                 - EReference: the owning Association element; null if not an association end. eContainingFeature().name      - Returns the name of the EReference via which p is contained; 'ownedAttribute' confirms the property is source-class-owned, not owned by the Association itself (ownedEnd). p1.eContainer() <> aClass      - Excludes self-associations: a self-association is exactly the case where the source-owned end is contained by aClass itself. ->collect(p2 | expr)           - Extracts the Association element from each qualifying property. ->filter(uml::Association)     - Retains only Association instances; also drops any null values safely. ->asOrderedSet()               - Deduplicates the result collection. ->sortedBy(a | a.name)         - Sorts result alphabetically by association name.
params: aClass - The target class whose incoming associations are to be retrieved.

name: u_outgoingAssociations
description: Returns an ordered set of all outgoing binary directed associations of the specified class, i.e. associations where this class owns the source end via ownedAttribute. The Association elements themselves are returned, not the target classes. --- AQL operations used: ownedAttribute             - EReference: properties structurally owned by this class (uml::Property). ->select(p1 | cond)        - Keeps only properties that are source ends of an association. p1.association             - EReference: the Association this property is a member end of; null if plain attribute. ->collect(p2 | expr)       - Extracts the Association element from each qualifying property. ->filter(uml::Association) - Retains only Association instances; also drops any null values safely. ->asOrderedSet()           - Deduplicates the result collection. ->sortedBy(a | a.name)     - Sorts result alphabetically by association name.
params: aClass - The source class whose outgoing associations are to be retrieved.

name: u_abstractionClients
description: Returns an ordered set of all classes that are abstraction clients of the specified class. Navigates the model's cross-references to find all uml::Abstraction relationships that list aClass as a supplier, then returns their client elements filtered to uml::Class instances. --- AQL operations used: aClass.eInverse(uml::Abstraction) - Navigates cross-references to return all uml::Abstraction instances that reference aClass (i.e. where aClass appears as a supplier). eInverse() is an AQL operation on EObject that returns all objects holding a reference to the receiver, optionally filtered by type. ->collect(a | a.client)           - For each Abstraction, collects its client NamedElements (the depending side of the relationship). ->filter(uml::Class)              - Retains only uml::Class instances, excluding other NamedElement subtypes (e.g. Interfaces). ->asOrderedSet()                  - Deduplicates; a class may appear as client in multiple Abstraction relationships. ->sortedBy(c | c.name)            - Sorts result alphabetically by name.
params: aClass - A UML class whose abstraction clients are to be retrieved.

name: u_abstractionSupplierClasses
description: Returns an ordered set of all classes that are abstraction suppliers of the specified class. Navigates the model's cross-references to find all uml::Abstraction relationships that list aClass as a client, then returns their supplier elements filtered to uml::Class instances. --- AQL operations used: aClass.eInverse(uml::Abstraction) - Navigates cross-references to return all uml::Abstraction instances that reference aClass (i.e. where aClass appears as a client). eInverse() is an AQL operation on EObject that returns all objects holding a reference to the receiver, optionally filtered by type. ->collect(a | a.supplier)         - For each Abstraction, collects its supplier NamedElements (the depended-upon side of the relationship). ->filter(uml::Class)              - Retains only uml::Class instances, excluding other NamedElement subtypes (e.g. Interfaces). ->asOrderedSet()                  - Deduplicates; a class may appear as supplier in multiple Abstraction relationships. ->sortedBy(c | c.name)            - Sorts result alphabetically by name.
params: aClass - A UML class whose abstraction suppliers are to be retrieved.

name: u_associations
description: Returns an ordered set of all associations in which the specified class participates as a typed end, sorted first by direction (outgoing before incoming) and then alphabetically by name within each group. Outgoing associations are those where aClass owns the source end (ownedEnd contains a property typed by the other class). Incoming associations are all remaining associations retrieved via eInverse('type').  Two associations between the same two classes are distinct EMF objects and are both retained in the result. The ->asOrderedSet() call only deduplicates cases where the same association object appears more than once, which occurs when both ends of a self-association are typed by aClass — in that case eInverse('type') yields the same association twice and ->asOrderedSet() correctly collapses it to one.  Note: excludes uml::Port instances since ->filter(uml::Property) retains only exact uml::Property matches. --- AQL operations used: aClass.eInverse('type')        - AQL operation on EObject: returns all EObjects that reference aClass via the 'type' EStructuralFeature, i.e. all typed elements whose type is aClass. ->filter(uml::Property)        - Retains only uml::Property instances, excluding other typed elements such as parameters or ports. ->select(p1 |                  - Retains only properties that p1.association->notEmpty())    belong to an association, excluding plain class attributes. ->collect(p2 | p2.association) - Collects the owning association of each retained property. ->select(a1 |                  - Separates outgoing associations: a1.ownedEnd->exists(           those where aClass owns a source e | e.type = aClass))        end, i.e. the end typed by aClass is owned by the association itself. ->reject(a2 |                  - Separates incoming associations: a2.ownedEnd->exists(           all associations not classified as e | e.type = aClass))        outgoing. ->asOrderedSet()               - Deduplicates self-associations within each group. ->sortedBy(a | a.name)         - Sorts each group alphabetically by name. ->union()                      - Combines outgoing (first) and incoming (second) groups, with outgoing appearing before incoming in the result.
params: aClass - A UML class whose participating associations are to be retrieved, ordered by direction then name.

name: u_contextClasses
description: Returns an ordered set of all classes forming the diagram context of the specified class. Combines classes reachable via direct associations, the full superclass hierarchy and their limited associations, the full subclass hierarchy, and abstraction relationships. Used for diagram context scoping, e.g. to determine which classes to include in a focused class diagram around aClass.  The result excludes aClass itself and is sorted alphabetically. The union terms contribute the following: 1. u_associatedClasses()       - Classes directly associated with aClass via incoming or outgoing binary associations. 2. u_allSuperClasses()         - All ancestors of aClass in the superclass hierarchy. 3. u_limitedAssociations()     - For each superclass, at most 3 -> u_ownedEndClass()          filtered associations; collect their owned end types. 4. u_limitedAssociations()     - Same filtered associations; -> u_otherEndClass()          collect their other end types. 5. u_allSubClasses()           - All descendants of aClass in the subclass hierarchy. 6. u_abstractionClients()      - Classes that depend on aClass via a uml::Abstraction relationship. 7. u_abstractionSupplierClasses()    - Classes that aClass depends on via a uml::Abstraction relationship. --- AQL operations used: u_associatedClasses()          - Query: returns classes directly associated with aClass via incoming or outgoing binary associations. u_allSuperClasses()            - Query: returns the ordered superclass hierarchy of aClass. ->collect(sc | expr)           - Collects results across all superclasses. u_limitedAssociations(aClass)  - Query: returns at most 3 filtered associations of a superclass, excluding those directly or indirectly connecting to aClass's hierarchy. u_ownedEndClass()              - Query: returns the type of the first owned end of an association as uml::Class. u_otherEndClass()              - Query: returns the type of the non-owned end of an association as uml::Class. u_allSubClasses()              - Query: returns all descendants of aClass in the subclass hierarchy. u_abstractionClients()         - Query: returns classes that list aClass as an abstraction supplier. u_abstractionSupplierClasses()       - Query: returns classes that aClass lists as an abstraction supplier. ->union(col)                   - Merges collections, deduplicating the combined result. ->asOrderedSet()               - Ensures the final merged result is a deduplicated OrderedSet. ->excluding(aClass)            - Removes aClass itself from the result. ->sortedBy(c | c.name)         - Sorts result alphabetically by name.
params: aClass - A UML class whose diagram context classes are to be retrieved.

name: u_inheritedAssociations
description: Returns an ordered set of associations inherited by the specified class from its superclass hierarchy. Collects all associations of each superclass and excludes those directly owned by aClass itself. Uses u_allSuperClasses() to traverse the full hierarchy and u_associations() to retrieve associations per superclass. --- AQL operations used: aClass.u_allSuperClasses()         - Query: returns the full ordered superclass hierarchy of aClass. ->collect(sc | sc.u_associations() - Collects all associations of ->reject(a |                       each superclass, excluding aClass.u_associations()          associations that aClass ->includes(a)))                itself directly participates in, to retain only truly inherited ones. ->asOrderedSet()                   - Deduplicates; the same association may be reachable via multiple levels of the superclass hierarchy. ->sortedBy(a | a.name)             - Sorts result alphabetically by association name.
params: aClass - A UML class whose inherited associations are to be retrieved.

name: u_attributes
description: Returns a sequence of owned attributes of the specified class, sorted by attribute name. Excludes association ends, retaining only plain attributes owned directly by the class. Note: See the overloaded variants for data types and classifiers: u_attributes(uml::DataType), u_attributes(uml::Classifier).
params: aClass - A UML class whose owned attributes are to be retrieved.

name: u_limitedAssociations
description: Returns an ordered set of at most 3 associations involving aSuperClass that are not directly connected to aClass and not connected to any of aClass's superclasses on both ends simultaneously. This reduces redundant Graphviz constraints parallel to the inheritance path.  The two filtering steps work as follows: 1. Exclude associations where either end directly connects to aClass. 2. Exclude associations where both ends are in aClass's superclass hierarchy (i.e. retain only those where at least one end is outside that hierarchy).  Associations are sorted by name before capping to ensure a deterministic result independent of traversal order. If more than 3 associations pass both filters, only the first 3 are returned. --- AQL operations used: aSuperClass.getAssociations()          - Java method on uml::Class: returns all associations in which aSuperClass participates as a member end. Not an EStructuralFeature; called with explicit parentheses in AQL. ->asOrderedSet()                       - Casts the result of getAssociations() to OrderedSet, required since getAssociations() does not return an OrderedSet in AQL. ->select(a | expr)                     - Filters the collection to elements satisfying the predicate. u_ownedEndClass()                      - Query: returns the type of the first owned end of the association as uml::Class. u_otherEndClass()                      - Query: returns the type of the non-owned end of the association as uml::Class. u_allSuperClasses()                    - Query: returns the ordered superclass hierarchy of aClass. ->excludes(obj)                        - Returns true if the collection does not contain obj. ->sortedBy(a | a.name)                 - Sorts associations alphabetically by name to ensure deterministic ordering before capping. ->size()                               - Returns the number of elements in the collection. ->subOrderedSet(1, 3)                  - Returns the first 3 elements of the ordered set.
params: aSuperClass - A UML class that is a superclass of aClass, whose associations are to be filtered. aClass - A UML class that is a subclass of aSuperClass, used as the exclusion reference.

name: u_associationEndsToOtherPackages
description: Returns a sequence of association-end properties owned by the specified class that point to a type in a different package.
params: aClass - A UML class whose outgoing cross-package association-end properties are to be retrieved.

name: u_associationEndsFromOtherPackages
description: Returns a sequence of association-end properties from other packages that reference the specified class.
params: aClass - A UML class that is referenced by the properties.

name: u_associationEndProperties
description: Returns the association-end properties owned by the specified class, i.e. navigable association ends declared on this class.
params: aClass - A UML class whose association-end properties are to be retrieved.

name: u_allSubClassesPlusSelf
description: Returns an ordered set of all subclasses of the specified class including the class itself, sorted by name.

name: u_allConcreteSubClassesPlusSelf
description: Returns an ordered set of all non-abstract subclasses of the specified class including the class itself if non-abstract, sorted by name.

name: u_contextPackages
description: Returns an ordered set of packages of the context classes of the specified class, excluding the class's own package, sorted by package name. See also: u_contextPackages(uml::DataType)

name: modelQuery
description: Module contains queries with a UML model as receiver. This includes queries for retrieving model metadata (acronym, title, version, URI, language), navigating the model structure (main package, all classes, all data types, all packages), and property file access.  Note: The main package is the top-level package of the model as specified by the property MAIN_PACKAGE_NAME. All generation targets operate on the main package rather than the model root directly.  Note: Model metadata is resolved in order of priority: (1) property file value, (2) ModelIdentification data type in the model, (3) built-in fallback value. This allows property file values to override model metadata without modifying the model.  Related modules: - packageQuery: queries with a UML package as receiver, since Model is a subtype of Package in UML - classQuery: queries with a UML class as receiver - dataTypeQuery: queries with a UML data type as receiver

name: u_mainPackage
description: Returns the main package for generation, determined by the 'MAIN_PACKAGE_NAME' property.  Property matching: The property value is matched against the qualified name of each package (uml::Package.qualifiedName), which includes the full path, e.g. 'MyModel::Domain::Core'. A simple unqualified name such as 'Core' will NOT match. If the property holds a simple name, use p.name instead.  Fallback to model: The model itself is returned as a uml::Package when: - 'MAIN_PACKAGE_NAME' is not set (empty string), - the property equals the model name, or - no package with the given qualified name is found. The second condition means that explicitly naming the model is treated the same as leaving the property unset.  Non-determinism: If multiple packages share the same qualified name across different subtrees, ->first() returns the first match in containment order. The model is assumed to contain unique qualified names, which is the standard UML constraint.  Type note: uml::Model is a specialisation of uml::Package, so returning aModel as uml::Package requires no cast.
params: aModel - The UML model being generated.

name: u_allAbstractionSuppliers
description: Returns an ordered set of all abstraction suplpier classes or data types contained in the specified model, without duplicates.

name: u_allAbstractionClients
description: Returns an ordered set of all abstraction client classes or data types contained in the specified model, without duplicates.

name: u_allClasses
description: Returns a sequence of all classes contained in the specified model, sorted by name.

name: u_allDataTypes
description: Returns a sequence of all proper data types contained in the specified model, excluding primitive types and enumerations, sorted by name.

name: u_allEnumerations
description: Returns a sequence of all enumerations contained in the specified model, sorted by name.

name: u_allPackages
description: Returns a sequence of all packages contained in the specified model, excluding the model itself, sorted by name.

name: u_subsetPackages
description: Returns an ordered set of package qualified name segments that contain at least one classifier whose simple name appears in u_subsetItems(). Each segment is a '::'-separated token of the qualifier prefix of a matching classifier's qualified name.

name: u_packagesWithClasses
description: Returns a sequence of packages that directly contain at least one class, sorted by package name.

name: associationQuery
description: Module contains queries with a UML association as receiver. This includes queries for navigating association ends (owned end, other end, source class, target class) and filtering associations for diagram generation purposes.  Note: Queries that find associations starting from a class are in classQuery, since their receiver is a UML class.  Related modules: - classQuery: queries with a UML class as receiver, including queries that find associations of a class - propertyQuery: queries with a UML property as receiver, since association ends are properties in UML

name: u_ownedEnd
description: Returns the source (subject) end of a binary directed association. A binary directed association can be understood as a triple: subject -- predicate (association name) --> object The source end is the subject end — owned by the association itself (ownedEnd) — as opposed to the target (object) end, which is owned by the source class via ownedAttribute. Note: Intended for use with binary directed associations only. See: u_otherEnd(uml::Association) - Returns the target (object) end.
params: anAssociation - A UML binary directed association whose source (subject) end is to be retrieved.

name: u_otherEnd
description: Returns the target (object) end of a binary directed association. A binary directed association can be understood as a triple: subject -- predicate (association name) --> object The target end is the object end — owned by the source class via ownedAttribute (memberEnd minus ownedEnd) — as opposed to the source (subject) end, which is owned by the association itself. Note: Intended for use with binary directed associations only. See: u_ownedEnd(uml::Association) - Returns the source (subject) end.
params: anAssociation - A UML binary directed association whose target (object) end is to be retrieved.

name: u_ownedEndClass
description: Returns the source (subject) class of a binary directed association. A binary directed association can be understood as a triple: subject -- predicate (association name) --> object The source class is the subject — the class from which the association originates. Delegates to u_ownedEnd() for end navigation and casts its type to uml::Class. Note: Intended for use with binary directed associations only. See: u_otherEndClass(uml::Association) - Returns the target (object) class.
params: anAssociation - A UML binary directed association whose source (subject) class is to be retrieved.

name: u_otherEndClass
description: Returns the target (object) class of a binary directed association. A binary directed association can be understood as a triple: subject -- predicate (association name) --> object The target class is the object — the class to which the association points. Delegates to u_otherEnd() for end navigation and casts its type to uml::Class. Note: Intended for use with binary directed associations only. See: u_ownedEndClass(uml::Association) - Returns the source (subject) class.
params: anAssociation - A UML binary directed association whose target (object) class is to be retrieved.

name: u_shortAssociationName
description: Returns the predicate (middle segment) of the association name, which follows the subject-predicate-object naming convention: <subject>_<predicate>_<object> Returns a warning string if the name does not conform: - 'WARNING: no association name!' if the name is empty. - the full name if no underscore is present, as the model may use simple association names without the convention. - 'WARNING: association name has only one underscore!' if only one underscore is present, making the predicate ambiguous.
params: anAssociation - A binary directed UML association whose name follows the subject_predicate_object convention, or a simple name.

name: typeQuery
description: Module contains queries with a UML type as receiver. This includes queries for retrieving the type name of both regular types and UML primitive types, and for classifying types as primitive or non-primitive.  Note: UML primitive types (String, Integer, Boolean, Real) require special handling since their name property is not directly accessible when loaded as proxies. The queries in this module provide a uniform interface for all type name retrieval regardless of whether the type is a primitive or a regular classifier.  Related modules: - classifierQuery: queries with a UML classifier as receiver, since Classifier is a subtype of Type - classQuery: queries with a UML class as receiver - dataTypeQuery: queries with a UML data type as receiver

name: u_isUmlPrimitive
description: Checks whether a given UML type is one of the five standard UML primitive types defined in the UML Primitive Types library (Boolean, Integer, String, Real, UnlimitedNatural), as opposed to a user-defined type.  The check first guards that the type is actually a uml::PrimitiveType, then compares the resource URI of the type against the known URI of the UML Primitive Types library resource. This is more reliable than a name-based check, since it is independent of user-defined types that may share names with standard ones.  Note: This query requires access to the element's containing resource via eResource() and is therefore not expressible in pure AQL. A Java service call is needed to resolve the resource URI.
params: aType The UML type to check (e.g. from a Property or Parameter).

name: elementQuery
description: Module contains queries with a UML element or named element as receiver.

name: u_model
description: Returns the root model that owns the specified element, by navigating up the containment hierarchy to the first uml::Model ancestor. Returns the element itself if it is already a uml::Model. AQL equivalent of getModel().
params: anElement - A UML element whose owning model is to be retrieved. May itself be a uml::Model.

name: u_parent
description: Returns the direct parent of the specified named element in the UML containment hierarchy. AQL equivalent of eContainer().
params: aNamedElement - A UML named element whose direct parent is to be retrieved.

name: u_nearestPackage
description: Returns the nearest containing package of the specified named element, by navigating up the containment hierarchy to the first uml::Package ancestor. - For a uml::Class or any non-package element: returns the directly owning package. - For a uml::Package: returns the parent package. - For a uml::Model (no container): returns itself as there is no parent package to navigate to.

name: u_packageQualifiedName
description: Returns the qualified name of the specified element in the form 'package::element', using the nearest containing package name.
params: anElement - A UML named element whose package-qualified name is to be retrieved.

name: OKu_commentBody
description: Returns the body of the first owned comment of the specified element if it exists, trimmed of leading and trailing spaces, or a warning message if the element has no comment and the 'WARNING_MISSING_DOCUMENTATION' property is set to true, or an empty string otherwise.
params: anElement - A UML element whose first comment body is to be retrieved.

name: u_shortDocumentation
description: Returns the first 100 characters of the first owned comment body of the specified element, followed by a newline and '...' if truncated. Returns a warning if there are no owned comments.

name: u_onlyDefinition
description: Returns the definition text extracted from the first owned comment of the specified named element: - strips section headings (Definition, Examples, Explanatory notes) - normalises whitespace - escapes curly braces as Unicode literals - truncates to 300 characters if longer Returns a warning string if there are no owned comments.

name: u_path
description: Returns the path of the specified element below the model root, using '/' as the separator between path segments.

name: u_namedElementByName
description: Returns a named element that is a direct or indirect child of the specified named element, matched by name. Returns null if not found.
params: aNamedElement - A UML named element used as search root. aName - The name to search for.

name: u_isInAllowedPackage
description: Returns true if the specified named element is a child of the main package and not contained in any ignored package listed in the IGNORE_PACKAGE property.

name: u_isNotInIgnoredPackage
description: Returns true if the specified named element is not contained in any package listed in the IGNORE_PACKAGE property (comma-separated list of package names).

name: u_isChildOfMainPackage
description: Returns true if the specified named element is a direct or indirect child of the main package.

name: u_filePath
description: Returns the output file path for the specified element and target format, using the model short name as the root segment. For the 'doc' target, the model name segment is replaced with '_rst'. Example: 'xsd' → 'shortName/xsd/pkg/ClassName' 'doc' → 'shortName/doc/_rst/pkg/ClassName'
params: aNamedElement - A UML named element. aTarget - The generation target format identifier (e.g. 'xsd', 'doc').

name: u_nearestPackageInformation
description: Returns the nearest DataType named 'PackageInformation' found by walking up the package containment hierarchy from aNamedElement.  Starting from the nearest owning package of aNamedElement, the query searches for a DataType named 'PackageInformation' in that package's direct contents. If none is found, it recurses upward through the package hierarchy. The model root is always searched before the recursion terminates — if no match is found at any level, null is returned.  Termination is guaranteed because u_nearestPackage() called on a uml::Package returns its owning package (not itself), so the recursion always moves upward and stops when the uml::Model root is reached.
params: aNamedElement - The UML named element from which to start the search.

name: u_packageInformation
description: Returns the PackageInformation or ModelIdentification DataType relevant to aNamedElement, supporting both structured models and legacy models.  Resolution order: (1) The nearest PackageInformation found by walking up the package hierarchy from aNamedElement (via u_nearestPackageInformation). (2) If none is found, any ModelIdentification present anywhere in the model — intended for legacy models that have a single ModelIdentification not placed at a specific package level. (3) null if no ModelIdentification exists anywhere in the model.
params: aNamedElement - The UML named element for which to resolve the PackageInformation or ModelIdentification.

name: u_packageInformationProperty
description: Returns the default value of a named property from the PackageInformation or ModelIdentification DataType relevant to aNamedElement, or an empty string if no ModelIdentification, no matching property, or no default value is found. Note: An explicit oclAsType(uml::Property) cast is required after ->first() because AQL loses the concrete type when the let binding's else branch returns null.
params: aNamedElement - The UML named element for which to resolve the ModelIdentification property. aPropertyName - The name of the property to retrieve (e.g. 'acronym', 'version', 'author').

name: u_modelLanguage
description: Returns the model language for aNamedElement. The value is determined in order of priority: (1) MODEL_LANGUAGE config property, (2) 'language' property of the relevant PackageInformation or ModelIdentification DataType, (3) 'en' as fallback.
params: aNamedElement - The UML named element for which to resolve the model language.

name: u_modelAcronym
description: Returns the model acronym for aNamedElement. The value is determined in order of priority: (1) MODEL_ACRONYM config property, (2) 'acronym' property of the relevant PackageInformation or ModelIdentification DataType, (3) the model name, (4) 'UNKNOWN_MODEL' as final fallback.
params: aNamedElement - The UML named element for which to resolve the model acronym.

name: u_modelMajorVersion
description: Returns the model major version for aNamedElement. The value is determined in order of priority: (1) MODEL_MAJOR_VERSION config property, (2) 'majorVersion' property of the relevant PackageInformation or ModelIdentification DataType, (3) 'NOT_SET' as fallback.
params: aNamedElement - The UML named element for which to resolve the model major version.

name: u_modelMinorVersion
description: Returns the model minor version version for aNamedElement. The value is determined in order of priority: (1) MODEL_MINOR_VERSION config property, (2) 'minorVersion' property of the relevant PackageInformation or ModelIdentification DataType, (3) 'NOT_SET' as fallback.
params: aNamedElement - The UML named element for which to resolve the model minor version version.

name: u_modelUri
description: Returns the model URI for aNamedElement. The value is determined in order of priority: (1) MODEL_URI config property, (2) 'uri' property of the relevant PackageInformation or ModelIdentification DataType, (3) 'NOT_SET' as fallback.
params: aNamedElement - The UML named element for which to resolve the model URI.

name: u_modelTitle
description: Returns the model title for aNamedElement. The value is determined in order of priority: (1) MODEL_TITLE config property, (2) 'title' property of the relevant PackageInformation or ModelIdentification DataType, (3) 'NOT_SET' as fallback.
params: aNamedElement - The UML named element for which to resolve the model title.

name: u_modelSubtitle
description: Returns the model subtitle for aNamedElement. The value is determined in order of priority: (1) MODEL_SUB_TITLE config property, (2) 'subtitle' property of the relevant PackageInformation or ModelIdentification DataType, (3) 'NOT_SET' as fallback.
params: aNamedElement - The UML named element for which to resolve the model subtitle.

name: u_modelXmiNamespace
description: Returns the model XMI namespace for aNamedElement. The value is determined in order of priority: (1) XMI_NAMESPACE config property, (2) 'xmiNamespace' property of the relevant PackageInformation or ModelIdentification DataType, (3) 'NOT_SET' as fallback.
params: aNamedElement - The UML named element for which to resolve the model XMI namespace.

name: u_modelRdfNamespace
description: Returns the model RDF namespace for aNamedElement. The value is determined in order of priority: (1) RDF_NAMESPACE config property, (2) 'rdfNamespace' property of the relevant PackageInformation or ModelIdentification DataType, (3) 'NOT_SET' as fallback.
params: aNamedElement - The UML named element for which to resolve the model RDF namespace.

name: u_modelRdfPrefix
description: Returns the model RDF preifx for aNamedElement. The value is determined in order of priority: (1) RDF_PREFIX config property, (2) 'rdfPrefix' property of the relevant PackageInformation or ModelIdentification DataType, (3) 'NOT_SET' as fallback.
params: aNamedElement - The UML named element for which to resolve the model RDF namespace.

name: classifierQuery
description: Module contains queries with a UML classifier as receiver, applicable to both calsses and data types.

name: u_subClassesOrSubDataTypes
description: Returns an ordered set of direct subclasses or sub data types of a classifier, sorted by classifier name. Note: Intended for use with classes and data types. Not tested with other classifier types.
params: aClassifier - A UML classifier whose direct subclasses or sub data types are to be retrieved.

name: u_allSuperClassifiers
description: Returns an ordered set of all super classifiers of a classifier, traversing the full generalization hierarchy up to the root. Supports both single and multiple inheritance. Cycle-safe. Covers all classifier subtypes including uml::Class, uml::DataType, uml::Interface, uml::Signal, uml::Component, etc. --- AQL operations used: ->closure(c | expr)    - Applied to aClassifier itself as seed; the lambda c.general is evaluated starting from aClassifier, so the direct parent is included from the first step. Traverses transitively until no new elements are found. Cycle-safe: each element is visited at most once.
params: aClassifier - A UML classifier whose full generalization hierarchy is to be retrieved.

name: u_attributes
description: Returns an ordered set of owned attributes of the specified classifier, sorted by attribute name. Supports uml::Class and uml::DataType only — returns an empty ordered set for any other classifier type. Excludes association ends. Note: See the overloaded, strongly typed variant for classes and data types: u_attributes(uml::Class), u_attributes(uml::DataType).
params: aClassifier - A UML classifier (class or data type) whose owned attributes are to be retrieved.

name: u_simpleQualifiedClassifierName
description: Returns the simple qualified name of a classifier in the form 'packageName::classifierName'.

name: propertyQuery
description: Module contains queries with a UML property as receiver. This includes queries for retrieving property metadata (multiplicity, cardinality), classifying properties as attributes or association ends, and navigating to the owning classifier or association.  Note: In UML, association ends are represented as properties. Queries in this module handle both plain attributes (association = null) and association ends (association <> null). The distinction is made explicit in the query documentation where relevant.  Note: Queries that find properties starting from a class or data type are in classQuery and dataTypeQuery respectively, since their receiver is the owning classifier rather than the property itself.  Related modules: - classQuery: queries with a UML class as receiver, including queries that find attributes and association ends of a class - dataTypeQuery: queries with a UML data type as receiver, including queries that find attributes of a data type - associationQuery: queries with a UML association as receiver, since association ends are properties

name: u_shexCardinality
description: Returns the cardinality of a property in ShEx syntax: '?' for 0..1, '*' for 0..*, '+' for 1..*, '' for all other cases.
params: aProperty - A UML property whose multiplicity is to be expressed as a ShEx cardinality string.

name: u_docMultiplicity
description: Returns the multiplicity of the specified property as a string in the format 'lower..upper', e.g. '0..1', '1..*'.
params: aProperty - A UML property whose multiplicity is to be retrieved.

name: u_isUnlimited
description: Returns true if the specified upper bound integer value is unlimited (i.e. -1). Note: unlimited is represented as -1, both in the UML metamodel and at runtime (regardless of the XMI serialization which can use the asterisk)
params: upper - A UML upper bound integer value.

name: stringQuery
description: Module contains queries with a String as receiver. This includes queries for string manipulation and formatting operations not available in the AQL standard library or that provide a more convenient interface for common patterns used across the generation templates.  Note: This module complements the AQL built-in string operations (replace, replaceAll, indexOf, tokenize, etc.) with additional utilities specific to the UCMIS generation context.  Related modules: - typeQuery: queries that retrieve type names as strings - namedElementQuery: queries that produce string representations of named elements such as paths and qualified names

name: u_removeEmptyLines
description: Returns the given text with consecutive empty or blank lines collapsed into a single newline. Removes lines consisting only of horizontal whitespace (spaces, tabs) between two line breaks. Note that \\h (horizontal whitespace character class) is a Java regex extension — it works in Acceleo since the underlying engine is Java's java.util.regex, but it is not standard POSIX regex.
params: txt - The string from which empty lines are to be removed.

name: u_repeatChar
description: Returns a string consisting of n repetitions of char.
params: char The character or string to repeat n The number of repetitions

name: m2tMaster
description: Master for generating target languages on the basis of a UML class model  The model should comply to UCMIS. See: https://bitbucket.org/ddi-alliance/ucmis/

name: processModel
description: Process a UML class model Options can be set in a property file. Current options are: ootest, doc. ootest - template for the generation of object-oriented languages It generates a file hierarchy corresponding to the package/class hierarchy in the model. This results in a file per package, per class, and per data type with detailed information.

name: representation
description: All templates in the *Doc.mtl modules generate reStructuredText for processing with Sphinx.

name: indentation
description: The documentation of the module indentation.

name: classJsonldCore
description: Generate the core of a type-scoped context for this class.

name: classJsonldSelfContained
description: Generates a complete self-contained type-scoped context for this class, as a sequence of contexts to be included in a JSON array.

name: classJsonldModular
description: Generates a modular standalone context for this cmass. Mostly used for the HTML documentation.

name: genAttributes
description: Generates context entries for the attributes of the classifier (class or dataType)

name: dataTypeJsonldCore
description: Generate the core of a type-scoped context for this datatype.

name: dataTypeJsonldSelfContained
description: Generates a complete self-contained type-scoped context for this datatype, as a sequence of contexts to be included in a JSON array.

name: dataTypeJsonldModular
description: Generates a modular standalone context for this datatype. Mostly used for the HTML documentation.

name: generateJsonld
description: This generator creates a root context which depends on one additional context for each class and datatype As this creates a lot of contexts, this does not scale very well when the contexts are loaded from the Web. An external script can be used to *inline* most of the class- and datatype-contexts in the root context, (this proved much more flexible than trying to generate the inline context directly).

name: processModelShex
description: Processes an UML class model according to the the rules described in the document "UML Class Interoperable Subset". See {@https://bitbucket.org/ddi-alliance/ucmis/}. Creates a file for the model.

name: dataTypeOnto
description: Module contains templates for .

name: enumerationXsd
description: Generates XML Schema code for an enumeration.

name: classXsd
description: Generates XML Schema code for a class.

name: propertyXsd
description: Generates XML Schema code for each attribute and association

name: modelXsdFile
description: All templates in the *Xsd.mtl modules generate XML Schema.

name: processModelXsd
description: Processes an UML class model complying to UCMIS. See: https://bitbucket.org/ddi-alliance/ucmis/ Creates a file for the model.

name: xsd_referenceClass
description: Generates XSD enumeration entries for a reference class type. If the class has concrete subclasses (or is itself concrete), one xs:enumeration element is emitted per concrete class. Otherwise, a single xs:enumeration for the class itself is emitted.
params: aType - A UML type, expected to be a Class.

name: xsd_upperCardinality
description: Returns the upper cardinality of the given property as an XSD string: unlimited is mapped to 'unbounded'; any other value is returned as its string representation.

name: xsd_typeName
description: Returns the XSD type name for the given UML type: - Boolean → xs:boolean - Integer → xs:integer - String  → xs:string - Real    → xs:double - XMLSchemaDataTypes package members → primitive via xsd_primitive() - Otherwise → <typeName>XsdType

name: xsd_primitive
description: Returns the XSD built-in type name for the specified UML type name string. Returns 'UNRESOLVED TYPE' if no mapping exists.  Supported mappings: 'XsdAnyUri'  → 'xs:anyURI' 'XsdDate'    → 'xs:date' 'XsdLanguage'→ 'xs:language'
params: aTypeName - The name of the UML primitive type to map.

name: xsd_escapeXmlCharacters
description: Returns the specified string with all XML special characters escaped: '&' → '&'  (replaced first to avoid double-escaping) '<' → '<' '>' → '>' '"' → '"' ''' → '''

name: dataTypeXsd
description: Generates XML Schema code for a data type.

name: ttl_prefixes
description: Emits the standard Turtle prefix declarations used across all generated TTL files, including the dynamic RDF prefix and namespace drawn from generator properties, and the fixed UCMIS namespace.
params: anEObject - A model element (used as receiver only; content is static).

name: iri
description: Compute the IRI for a given element. NB: I was not able to retrieve the xmi:uuid, so I rebuild an IRI here. This may need to be adapted. TODO: maybe this should be a query rather than a template? (no need to post-process... Current version uses short id Previous versions are iri1 (the xmi:id, not xmi:uuid which does not seem to be retrievable) and iri2.

name: fragment
description: Creates a local fragment IRI named after x.

name: fragmentRev
description: Creates a local fragment IRI named after x.

name: rdfs_comment
description: Converts a UML comment into an RDFS comment.

name: iriEscape
description: Ensure that the IRI is valid and Turtle friendly. TODO: at the moment, the 'valid' part is not really checked, and the 'turtle friendly' part is managed in a very ad-hoc way

name: cdiAdHoc
description: TODO As its name imply, this method is specific to CDI. Ultimately, what it does should be generically supported by using UML traces, then it must be removed and its uses replaced with iriEscape. JW: Is it specific to CDI or to UCMIS?

description: The documentation of the template allClassesList.

description: The documentation of the template allClassesList.
